title: Back to Mandalore
description: Leader of the New Mandalorians during the Clone Wars, Duchess Satine Kryze was a true friend to the Galactic Senate and a powerful, ambitious leader. She became close friends with Obi-Wan Kenobi over the years, having true love for the Jedi Master. After Mandalore was conquered by Darth Maul, Kryze's government was_overthrown and its former rulers imprisoned. Obi-Wan attempted to rescue Satine; only to have her die in his arms after she was Force-choked to death by the vengeful Darth Maul.
